text:
Noah Park: Hey everyone! I’m Noah — starting today in the SF office (he/him). Infra ML engineer by day, terrible chiptune player by night. I collect handheld consoles and I bring a spare Game Boy to lunch sometimes. Also allergic to shellfish. Excited to be here! :tada:

HR Bot: Welcome Noah! Your onboarding buddy is Samir. We emailed the schedule. Badge will be at reception (bring ID). If you need IT access, reply here and we'll loop in infra-access.

Samir: hey noah!! welcome :raised_hands: i'll swing by with a campus map. lunch plans today? ramen on 3rd floor at 12:30 if you wanna join.

Lena: welcome!! if you’re into chiptune we have a tiny synth jam on Fridays in the lounge — bring whatever makes noise 🎹

Mike: welcome Noah — ping me for infra runbooks. also fyi the secret keyboard dragon is sacred, do not unplug. (kidding) :joy:

Juno: fridge labels are real — please write your name on leftovers. also someone stole my kombucha last week so trust no one.

Anna: quick poll for boba lovers: react 1️⃣ = classic milk tea, 2️⃣ = cheese foam oolong, 3️⃣ = no boba.

Samir: 1️⃣

Lena: 2️⃣

Noah Park: 2️⃣ — cheese foam oolong all the way. I brought a spare copy of Tetris (Game Boy) if anyone’s down to duel at lunch. See you at 12:30! :)

Mike: hype. see you then :sunglasses:
